title: 第十五章 命运同盟因塔斯上第十六章 命运同盟因塔斯下
lines: 赭石谷核心区的野兽，基本都被雏龙们吃光了，这时候还想找大型猎物，就得不断往外围走。
因塔斯没有铬龙那样的灵敏，但他的狩猎本能却也很好，能持续不断追踪气味，在脑海里勾勒地图，计算出猎物的活动范围，
依靠这个能力，因塔斯花了半个下午的时间蹲守，成功见到一只警惕的岩羊。
鸣雷龙猛扑出去，干脆利落，直接将其咬死在地上。
狩猎成功，因塔斯却没有立刻大快朵颐，反倒是叼着岩羊把它衔起来，一路小跑，沿着丘陵往回走，留下一连串星星点点的血迹。
越过眷属棚户区，途经湾湖和铁木林，绕到山麓的另一侧，下一段缓坡，可以看见一座隐在岩石下的巢穴。
西隆站在巢穴外面，一点点将右翼张开抬起，接着又缓慢落下贴缩，如此循坏反复，他断裂的骨骼已经接续痊愈，此时所作所为，算是康复训练。
鸣雷龙放下岩羊，一双灰白的眼睛直勾勾看着他。
目光扎人，西隆却也不介意，只是平静的收敛动作，转头看向鸣雷龙，“因塔斯，你怎么来了？”
“我说过的，我的狩猎本能很好，如果你愿意指导我训练，我可以帮你狩猎。”
鸣雷龙说，声音听不出什么起伏，“你膜翼的伤势很坏，需要更多食物。”
其实他们已经认识了一段时间。
两个月前，西隆攀岩结束，正蹲在角落里嚼食锈兔，锈兔是他从莫奇手里抢来的，作为训练之后的加餐，这样吃起来，反倒比血食更加满足。
随着一段悉悉索索的声音，鸣雷龙出现在他面前。
因塔斯向西隆垂首致意，算是打过招呼，接着表明来意，说自己观察他的时间已经很久，今后想要跟随西隆一起训练。
自从破壳之后，西隆便一直在鹰嘴崖、湾湖和铁木林里流连辗转，其他雏龙见得多了，以龙类的智慧，大致推断一下，基本都能猜到他是在做什么。
对于西隆的日常训练，雏龙们的看法不一，有私下议论的、有嗤之以鼻的，当然也有想要学习模仿的。
譬如莫奇，一开始觉得新奇好玩，就打算跟着西隆尝试一番，结果只是半天就喊累到不行，不愿坚持。
其他想要学习模仿的龙，大抵也都是如此。
龙类的天性就是这样，它们血统高贵又聪慧异常，生来就知道自己注定会登上食物链顶端，即使会被击败，也是被天赋更高、血统更强的龙类击败。
所以类似的训练，对大多数雏龙来说，完全是自讨苦吃，就像喂哺者下达的磨牙任务，它们也同样不愿坚持。
雏龙兴致勃勃模仿、半途而废放弃的事情，西隆见了不少，所以对因塔斯的接近，既谈不上热络，也不拒绝疏离，只是说，
“我这些都是浅白的方法，没什么可教你的，既然你知道怎么观察，那就在近处多看一些吧，看明白之后，照着做就可以了。”
从此西隆不再形单影只，从赭石谷的底部看去，常常可以看见一条鸣雷龙跟在他身后，照着铬龙的样子学习模仿。
磕磕绊绊、踉踉跄跄。
“我说过了，我没有教给过你什么，所以也不需要你帮我狩猎。”
直到今天，西隆也仍然还是摇头，说，“你带回去，自己吃吧。”
鸣雷龙直直站立，静默不动。
西隆看他一眼，知道这家伙愣劲又上来了，当初莫奇评价鸣雷龙“傻乎乎的”，还真有一定道理。
不过，要不是有这股愣劲，鸣雷龙也下不了苦功，他一直跟在西隆身后模仿，哪怕受伤流血，也从没喊过疼痛苦累。
这么多雏龙尝试复刻西隆的训练，唯独鸣雷龙坚持的时间最久。
西隆倒也不是矫情扭捏的性格，眼看因塔斯不愿离开，便琢磨了一阵，迈步上去。
铬龙用爪子一划，把岩羊整个剖开，一分为二。
content_en:
Most of the beasts in the core area of ​​Ocher Valley have been eaten by the young dragons. If you still want to find large prey at this time, you have to keep walking to the outside.
Intus is not as agile as the Chrome Dragon, but his hunting instinct is also very good. He can continuously track scents, draw maps in his mind, and calculate the range of prey.
Relying on this ability, Intas spent half the afternoon squatting and successfully saw a vigilant blue sheep.
The Thunder Dragon pounced out and bit it to death directly on the ground.
The hunt was successful, but Intas did not feast immediately. Instead, he picked up the blue sheep in his mouth and trotted back along the hills, leaving behind a series of dots of blood.
After crossing the family shanty town, passing through Bay Lake and Ironwood Forest, we walked around to the other side of the foothills. Down a gentle slope, we could see a nest hidden under a rock.
Shillong stood outside the nest, opening and lifting his right wing little by little, and then slowly lowering and contracting it. This cycle was repeated, and his broken bones had been healed. What he was doing at this time was regarded as rehabilitation training.
Thunder Dragon put down the blue sheep and looked directly at him with a pair of gray eyes.
The glare was piercing, but Shillong didn't mind. He just calmly restrained his movements and turned to look at the Thunder Dragon, "Intas, why are you here?"
"As I said, my hunting instinct is very good. If you are willing to guide me in training, I can help you hunt."
Thunder Dragon said, with no discernible fluctuation in his voice, "Your membrane wing is badly injured and needs more food."
In fact, they have known each other for a while.
Two months ago, Shillong finished rock climbing and was squatting in a corner chewing a rusty rabbit. He had snatched the rusty rabbit from Mo Qi as a snack after training. Eating it this way was actually more satisfying than blood food.
Following a rustling sound, the Thunder Dragon appeared in front of him.
Intas bowed his head to Shillong as a greeting, and then expressed his intention to come, saying that he had been observing him for a long time and wanted to train with Shillong in the future.
Since breaking out of his shell, Shillong has been wandering around Eagle Beak Cliff, Bay Lake and Ironwood Forest. He has seen many other young dragons. With the wisdom of dragons, you can basically guess what he is doing.
Regarding Shillong's daily training, the young dragons have different opinions. Some are talking privately, some are scornful, and of course some want to learn to imitate.
For example, Mo Qi thought it was novel and fun at first, so he planned to try it with Shillong. However, after only half a day, he complained that he was too tired and refused to persist.
This is probably the case for other dragons who want to learn to imitate.
This is the nature of dragons. They are of noble blood and extremely intelligent. They are born knowing that they are destined to be at the top of the food chain. Even if they are defeated, they will be defeated by dragons with higher talents and stronger bloodlines.
Therefore, similar training, for most young dragons, is completely asking for trouble, just like the teeth grinding task assigned by the feeder, they are also unwilling to persist.
Shillong has seen a lot of things that young dragons imitate enthusiastically and give up halfway, so the approach to Intas is neither warm nor distant, but just saying,
"These are just simple methods. I have nothing to teach you. Since you know how to observe, just observe more at a closer distance. Once you understand it, just follow it."
From then on, Shillong was no longer alone. Looking from the bottom of the Ocher Valley, one could often see a Thunder Dragon following behind him, imitating the Chromium Dragon.
Stumbling, stumbling.
"I said, I haven't taught you anything, so I don't need you to help me hunt."
To this day, Shillong still shakes his head and says, "Take it back and eat it yourself."
The thunder dragon stood upright and silent.
Shillong glanced at him and knew that this guy was getting mad again. Moqi's original comment about Thunder Dragon as "silly" really made sense.
However, if it weren't for this stupidity, Thunder Dragon wouldn't have been able to work hard. He kept following Shillong and imitated it. Even if he was injured and bleeding, he never cried out about pain or tiredness.
With so many young dragons trying to replicate Shillong's training, only Thunder Dragon persisted the longest.
Shillong was not a coy character. Seeing that Intas didn't want to leave, he thought about it for a while and stepped forward.
The Chrome Dragon used its claws to slice open the blue sheep and split it into two.
